reason: The verifier is right that the two Pomerans printings differ. The Open Library full-text index of the archive.org scans shows the Pantheon 1983, Washington Square 1985 and Triad 1985 printings reading "more and more peace and to reflect it towards others" (no comma, towards), and the Henry Holt 1996 scan (interruptedlifet00hill) reading "more and more peace, and to reflect it toward others" (comma, toward). The shipped wording matches the Holt 1996 text exactly and the source names that edition, so no drift. Page 218 is independently confirmed by the Center for Action and Contemplation, which cites Holt 1996 at 218 for this passage (and Pantheon 1984 at 185 for the towards version), and by quotesjournal. The 29 September 1942 date is the one every dated reproduction gives and is consistent with the CAC citation of the 8 October entry at Holt 227; I could not open the page itself, so the date rests on that convergence.
